phase: formula-pass (blind, stage A only; no claims seen)

identity.normalization: ID-2: 'AQUA (WATER)' is one entry; no split entries; packet positions equal normalized one-based positions. Source tier 4 (fallback retailer) noted; packet marks the formula complete.

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate by C1: defining anionic Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate @2 (ether/sulfonate type), prominent buffer Cocamidopropyl Betaine @3, no reinforcing strong anionic. Cocamide DIPA @4 is an alkanolamide (not a route, not a buffer).

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: several light routes, all after Parfum @9 (not prominent): Butyrospermum Parkii Butter @10, Polyester-37 @11, Glycol Distearate @13, Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride @15, Polyquaternium-39 @19, with Glycerin @5 and Panthenol @14. C2 not met: no prominent silicone and no prominent payload lipid (shea is after the E3 point). Because every conditioning route is post-E3, low is the realistic neighbor.

wLine.plausibility: (i) Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate @2 before it; (ii) only PEG-150 Distearate @8 lies between it and the cap, and PEG thickeners are not structurants for (ii).

weightPotential.depositionLoad: light: two cationic polymers and a film former, all listed after Parfum @9 and the preservative @7; shea non-material.
weightPotential.persistence: low-to-moderate: cationic and film-polymer deposition can be retained, but at trace positions; no silicone; waxy shea is post-line.
weightPotential.counterevidence: Three deposition families present (cationic_polymer x2, film_former, non-material payload_lipid); cationic polymers deposit at low dose by dilution deposition, so late listing does not make them weightless.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Low: every deposition route sits in the trace zone after Phenoxyethanol @7 and Parfum @9, against an effective C1 reset; nothing converges at a meaningful dose.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate (W2): each family is late/trace in the list (Polyester-37 @11, guar @15, Polyquaternium-39 @19 all after Parfum @9), the only lipid (shea @10) is after the W-line @7, and there is no silicone; the AOS/betaine reset faces only these light routes.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Several low-dose cationic/film routes converge; if their combined deposition is noticeable the band is moderate.
weightPotential.rationale: Low: late/trace cationic polymers and film former, non-material shea (W-line @7), moderate C1 reset; moderate is the neighbor because three families are present.

careDirection.limitation: All care routes post-E3; formula is compatible with volume (film polymer Polyester-37, light deposition) but distinguishes no repair/moisture direction.
